title: Benchmark for CEC 2024 Competition on Multiparty Multiobjective Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on defining and presenting a benchmark suite for Multiparty Multiobjective Optimization Problems, specifically including UAV path planning with efficiency and safety objectives. The safety objectives (fatality risk, property risk, noise pollution) are treated as quantitative metrics to be optimized, not as a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics in a broader philosophical sense as specified in the prompt.
